welcome.title: The Whispering Hollow
welcome.subtitle: A fantasy paragraph game
welcome.name: Your hero's name
welcome.preview: Hello, {playerName}! A {characterClass} starts with {hp} hit points.

start.text: Mist clings to the edge of the Whispering Hollow. {playerName}, you stand with {hp} hit points and a heavy purse of doubt. A cave yawns to the north; a muddy road bends east toward a lantern-lit stall.

road.text: A merchant waves you over. "A {characterClass}, is it? You will want this, {playerName}. Only a few coppers." He holds up a small red potion.

roadAfter.text: The road ends where it began: in front of the cave. You have {itemCount} item(s) and {hp} hit points. There is nowhere left to go but in.

cave.text: Gold glitters in the dark, and on top of it sleeps a dragon the size of a barn. Its breath rattles the coins. You could creep past it, {playerName}, or you could strike first.

fight.text: The dragon's tail catches you in the ribs. You are down to {hp} of {maxHp} hit points, and it is wide awake.

choices.usePotion: Drink your healing potion and finish it
choices.fightOn: Fight on with everything you have

victory.text: You walk out of the Hollow with a dragon coin in your pocket and {hp} hit points left. The mist parts for you. Well done, {playerName} the {characterClass}.

defeat.text: The mist closes in. {playerName}, your story ends here, with {hp} hit points left and the dragon's laughter in your ears.
